recommendation_summary: Add a Lookup sheet to the existing Excel workbook. It has one input cell for the part code, plus XLOOKUP formulas (or VLOOKUP if XLOOKUP isn't available) that return the shelf location and price, with a "Not found" fallback. Retool, Supabase and Next.js are rejected.
note: The recommendation is correctly small and stays in Excel, but the reply has none of the four labelled record lines.
